title: Facebook Page Posts Scraper input
description: Extract public posts from pages, profiles, groups, or a single post URL.

pageOrUrl.title: Page, profile, group, or post URL
pageOrUrl.description: Page/profile handle, group URL, or single post URL. Extracts public post data. Private or login-gated targets return an explanatory error row.

maxPosts.title: Max recent posts from page feed
maxPosts.description: Maximum recent feed posts to extract. Ignored for a single post URL or when filtering by date.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: async = streaming httpx (recommended on Apify); threads = requests thread pool.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify residential proxy (on by default). Main reliability lever. If runs return 0 posts for a public target, set proxy country to match the audience (or your country) and retry — wrong exits often get empty feeds.

afterDate.title: Posts on or after
afterDate.description: Calendar date. Keep posts from this day onward (inclusive), using midnight in dateTimezone. Leave empty for no lower bound. Example: pick 2026-07-31 and set "Posts before" to 2026-08-01 for that local day only.

beforeDate.title: Posts before
beforeDate.description: Calendar date. Keep posts strictly before this day (exclusive), using midnight in dateTimezone. Leave empty for no upper bound. When using a date filter, afterDate is required so pagination knows when to stop.

dateTimezone.title: Date timezone
dateTimezone.description: Timezone for afterDate/beforeDate midnight. Use UTC (default), an offset like +3 or +03:00, or an IANA name (Africa/Khartoum, Asia/Riyadh). Unix afterTime/beforeTime ignore this.
